metadata.remarks:
Identity Assurance defines the capability to evaluate, express, and propagate confidence in identity assertions based on authentication strength, contextual risk, and observed behavior. Assurance enables adaptive access decisions and consistent trust signaling across systems.

Governance and Responsibility Anchor:
This pattern is the authoritative anchor for roles and responsibilities, SSPPs, standards, procedures, guidelines, and assurance activities related to identity confidence and assurance. Controls are intentionally scoped to specific assurance sub-capabilities.

components.title: Assurance Levels
components.description: Definition and classification of assurance levels representing confidence in identity assertions.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Define and apply strength-of-mechanism and assurance requirements for identities.

components.title: Confidence Signals
components.description: Collection and evaluation of signals contributing to identity confidence, such as authentication method, device posture, and behavioral indicators.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Monitor and assess signals relevant to identity confidence and risk.

components.title: Risk Context
components.description: Incorporation of contextual and situational risk into identity assurance evaluations.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Assess risk related to identity usage and access context.
Adjust required assurance based on assessed risk.

components.title: Assurance Propagation
components.description: Propagation of identity assurance claims and confidence levels across relying services and systems.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Ensure assurance claims are correctly conveyed and enforced by relying parties.
Generate audit records for assurance evaluation and propagation events.
